signals.text: Revenue grew 16% a year over 3 years vs 21% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 21% vs revenue at 16%: operating leverage is showing.
Operating margin expanded 66 bps in 3 years (11.1% → 11.7%).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 118% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

flags.text: Revenue grew 16% a year over 3 years vs 21% over 5: growth is slowing.

guidance.statement: The company expects growth of over 10% this year compared to last year.
guidance.quote: The broad expectation, which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year.

guidance.statement: The company is looking at a INR14,000 crore capex for the full year FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, on the capex for FY 26-27, we are looking at a INR14,000 crores capex for the full year.

guidance.statement: The company has plans to increase production capacity to 4 million units per annum in the medium term.
guidance.quote: Besides, the company has put plans in place to increase the production capacity to 4 million units per annum in the medium term.

guidance.statement: The company aims to enable a network of over 100,000 charging points across India by 2030.
guidance.quote: our aim is to enable a network of over 1 lakh charging points across India by 2030, along with our dealers and charge point operators.

delivered.statement: Recorded highest ever annual sales of 2.42 million vehicles, including record 447,000 exports.
Achieved record net sales of over INR1.74 trillion in FY26, a 20.2% growth.
Achieved all-time high net profit of over INR144.4 billion in FY26.
Recorded highest ever quarterly sales of 676,209 units in Q4 FY26, up 11.8% year-on-year.
Achieved record net sales of about INR500.79 billion in Q4 FY26.
EBIT reached an all-time high of over INR44 billion in Q4 FY26, up 30.4% year-on-year.

calls.tone: confident on demand and capacity expansion, cautious on short-term geopolitical and commodity headwinds

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the impact of commodity and steel repricing on margins and whether pressures will persist in Q1.
Analysts pressed on the sustainability of the INR750 crores MTM hit on other income and potential for reversal.
Questions were raised regarding CAFE norms, powertrain mix, EV salience, and cost impact of flex-fuels.

credibility.line: All promises pending; profitability and margins sharply deteriorated post-call despite confident tone, raising concerns about future execution.
